senses.gloss: m. (σισύρνα) a garment made of goat-skin with the hair on.—Pl. סוּסִרְנַיָּה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:3:2">Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ</cite> <he>כגין אילין ס׳</he> (not <he>סוסרנה</he>) like those garments made of goat-skins (the hair of which is not used for clothing).—V. <cite ref="O00766"><he>סִיסִרְנוֹן</he></cite>.
